name: know-week
note: Whether a run reaches for the recurring-week page when it plans around a day or a recurring commitment, and leaves it alone for work with no schedule dependency.

cases.prompt: Find two hours on a specified weekday for a planning session and name the recurring commitments you worked around.
cases.why: placing work on a day requires the recurring-week page so the plan accounts for the commitments already on that day.

cases.prompt: What recurring commitments fall on a specified weekday?
cases.why: the recurring-week page is the source for commitments that may not be in a calendar feed.

cases.prompt: When does a recurring group event take place?
cases.why: a recurring event is answered from the recurring-week page rather than guessed from a calendar.

cases.prompt: List the fields a database table declares.
cases.why: a field list is read from the schema and has no schedule dependency.

cases.prompt: Write the commit message for a change to a service poller.
cases.why: a commit message is for the repository and carries no recurring-week information.

cases.prompt: Explain a repository mechanism to Tom.
cases.why: an explanation of a mechanism has no schedule dependency.
